parsed.explanation: The optimal approach generates all 2^n subsets in O(n · 2^n) time and space using bit manipulation or recursive backtracking, matching the lower bound dictated by the output size. Because the search space grows exponentially, production systems strictly limit exhaustive generation to tiny inputs (typically n ≤ 20) and otherwise rely on branch pruning, approximation, or heuristic search.
